basic_details.job_title: TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences Hyderabad – Off Campus is filling one Programme Manager post on contract for one year initially, extendable based on performance and the Institute's requirement, at a consolidated salary of Rs.40,000/-. The post needs M.Com or MBA (Finance) with minimum 2 years' experience in accounts and finance. Apply online at tiss.ac.in/admin-positions by 22 November 2026; the advertisement is dated 12 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the application page named in the notice, https://tiss.ac.in/admin-positions/, and apply online by 22 November 2026.
Pay the application fee online if it applies to you. The application is valid only on receipt of the fee from those who are required to pay.
SC/ST/PWD candidates upload the required certificate in the Online Application Form to get the reduced fee of Rs 250/-.
Take a print of the acknowledgment of the online application and keep it for future reference.
The fee is paid online. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.
The required certificate for SC/ST/PWD candidates, uploaded in the Online Application Form.

content_sections.heading: TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager at a Glance

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences Hyderabad – Off Campus
Contract basis for one year initially, extendable based on performance of the candidate and the requirement of the Institute
Rs 500/-; Rs 250/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates who upload the required certificate; women applicants exempted

content_sections.heading: About TISS Hyderabad
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences, established in 1936, is a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a Grant-in-Aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Govt of India. It has its main campus at Mumbai and off-campuses at Tuljapur, Guwahati and Hyderabad. This recruitment is for the Hyderabad Off Campus; the employer is a government-aided university.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces one post. The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to a reserved category are encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is preferably below 40 years. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. The Institute reserves the right to relax the age of the candidate based on the work experience. It is the candidate's own responsibility to assess eligibility against the prescribed qualifications and experience. The notice's own wording of the age limit and the qualification is the final reference for each condition.

rows.educational_qualification_and_experience: M.Com, MBA (Finance); experience minimum 2 years in accounts and finance

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is Rs.40,000/-. The post is on contract for one year initially. The contract may be extended based on the candidate's performance and the Institute's requirement. Selected candidates are expected to join duty within 10 days of receipt of the offer letter. The Institute also reserves the right to offer a position with a lower designation and pay, according to the suitability of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work under the heading "Accounts": Maintain project accounts, prepare budgets and financial reports, process payments, manage TDS/GST compliance, P-Tax. Coordinate audits, maintain vouchers and financial records, and provide administrative support. Budget tracking, vendor payments, expense verification, financial documentation, reporting, and coordination with finance and project teams.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the application page named in the notice, https://tiss.ac.in/admin-positions/ , and apply online by 22 November 2026. Pay the application fee online if it applies to you. The application is valid only on receipt of the fee from those who are required to pay. SC/ST/PWD candidates upload the required certificate in the Online Application Form to get the reduced fee of Rs 250/-. Take a print of the acknowledgment of the online application and keep it for future reference. The fee is paid online. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The required certificate for SC/ST/PWD candidates, uploaded in the Online Application Form.

rows.category: SC/ST/PWD (with the required certificate uploaded in the Online Application Form)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be shortlisted. In case of high response, merely having the prescribed minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a person to be called for Personal Interaction (Offline/Online). Shortlisted candidates may be invited for a Written test, Personal Interaction or skill test to evaluate their proficiency and skills. They will be informed by e-mail and/or mobile phone to appear for the Written/Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Hyderabad. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the Personal Interaction if it is held at the Institute's premises. The notice does not print a date for the interaction.

faq.question: Q1. How many Programme Manager posts are there at TISS Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 post of Programme Manager at the Hyderabad Campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: The last date of filling of online applications is 22 November 2026 (22.11.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: The post requires M.Com or MBA (Finance), with experience of minimum 2 years in accounts and finance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 40 years. The Institute reserves the right to relax the age of the candidate based on the work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs.40,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee, and are women exempted?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 500/-, paid online. SC/ST/PWD candidates pay Rs 250/- if they upload the required certificate in the Online Application Form. Women applicants are exempted. Paid fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://tiss.ac.in/admin-positions/ by 22 November 2026, and keep a print of the acknowledgment of the online application.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates may be invited for a Written test, Personal Interaction or skill test at TISS, Hyderabad. They are informed by e-mail and/or mobile phone.

faq.question: Q9. Is the TISS Hyderabad Programme Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract basis for one year initially, extendable based on the candidate's performance and the Institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates who applied earlier need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who applied under the June 2026 (19.06.2026) and July 2026 (08.07.2026) advertisements and subsequent need not apply again; their applications will be considered with those received now.
